items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: this, this rhythm would fit with the, uh, the wheels of, of, of, of Smokey Berry

ctx.x: I, I just used that as, as, as, as a type. I didn't even know, oh, what to call it at that time. Uh-huh. Only when I wrote, wrote the story about it. Yeah. You see what I mean? It was different kind of a, of a feeling that I felt, uh, this, this rhythm would fit with the, uh, the wheels of, of, of, of Smokey Berry, see? Yeah. So, like I said, I played all different, they had names for, for all these different kind of, uh, kind of rhythms later on. Uh-huh. But, I don't say I invented it.
